g.text: V7 retained subtypes + marker fallback | vascular / stromal / tissue lineages
Top: corresponding parent identity or separate RNA programme. Left: frozen name and included cell count.
Size: detection among source-measured cells; x: source coverage <80%. Color: relative expression within each gene.
Previous named subtypes are retained; only unfinished annotations use major-plus-marker fallback.
Inherited names are not new subtype validations. QC, state, CNV and audit history remain separate.
